page_title: JUV 2-2 ATA | Juventus v Atalanta 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch so that Matteo Ruggeri can be given a rest.
88' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere will be replaced by Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta).
88' It is time for a substitution. Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is on for Weston McKennie.
86' Alex Sandro (Juventus) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.
83' Here is a change. Andrea Cambiaso is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Timothy Weah (Juventus).
82' The game is interrupted. Bremer (Juventus) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
82' Substitution. Samuel Iling Junior will be replaced by Alex Sandro (Juventus).
82' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
80' Weston McKennie (Juventus) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Guida no option but to blow his whistle.
79' Federico Gatti (Juventus) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
78' Federico Gatti (Juventus) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.

77' Juventus are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
76' Substitution. Moise Kean (Juventus) in, Arkadiusz Milik out.
76' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) replacing Fabio Miretti.
75' 2 - 2 Goal! Berat Djimsiti tees up Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 2:2.
70' 2 - 1 Goal! Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper low inside the middle of the net. 2:1.
69' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Federico Chiesa (Juventus). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
67' It's time for a substitution. Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) comes on in place of Giorgio Scalvini.
67' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Davide Zappacosta and he is replaced by Hans Hateboer (Atalanta).

66' 1 - 1 Goal! Weston McKennie produces a great pass that finds Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
63' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
60' Ederson (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for an infringement.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is coming onto the pitch as Gianluca Scamacca cannot continue after picking up an injury.
57' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Fabio Miretti (Juventus) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
56' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the right post.
52' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.

50' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) was in a good shooting position inside the six-yard box and produced a first-time shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper made an astonishing save to thwart him.
46' The second half has just started.
45' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
44' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
38' Juventus are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

35' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Mario Pasalic plays the ball to the feet of Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta), who hits a tremendous first-time shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 0:1.
30' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile.
28' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
25' Marco Guida blows for a foul after Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Juventus earn a free kick.
22' Juventus are ruled offside.
18' Atalanta keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
15' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) takes the free kick from distance but the defensive wall makes the block.
13' Marco Carnesecchi makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Fabio Miretti (Juventus) after a cross from the side.
12' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
10' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
10' Marco Guida has a clear sight and sees a foul from Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).
9' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
8' The ball is cleared after Federico Chiesa (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) strikes the ball harmlessly from a long-range free kick and it goes high over the bar. It's not easy to score from a distance like that.
4' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Juventus will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Marco Guida.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
